lastMessage:
feat: implement manifest webhook notifications in CI workflows

- Added a composite action `/.github/actions/notify-manifest-webhook` to centralize webhook notifications for manifest updates.
- Integrated webhook notifications into all manifest generation workflows, ensuring API caches are refreshed automatically.
- Updated CI workflows to use repository secrets for webhook configuration, enhancing security and maintainability.
- Documented the new webhook integration in `README.md`, `docs/manifest-cdn.md`, and `docs/learned/manifest-webhook-integration.md`.
- Added tests for the webhook notification action to ensure it behaves correctly with and without secrets.
\n\nAuthor: mccal
